CONSULTING AGREEMENT
This Consulting Agreement (the "Agreement") is made as of 02 Jun 2025 (the "Effective
Date") by and between Vantage Point Consulting, a California company ("Consultant"), and
Cobalt Peak Software, a Georgia company ("Company").
1. SCOPE. Consultant shall provide data and reporting advisory services as requested by
Company and shall not subcontract any work without written consent.
2. TERM. This Agreement begins on the Effective Date and ends on June 2, 2027, unless
terminated earlier under Section 6.
3. PAYMENT. Company shall pay Consultant $110 per hour, invoiced monthly and payable
within fifteen (15) days of the invoice date.
4. CONFIDENTIALITY. Each party shall keep the other party's confidential information
secret, use it only to perform this Agreement, and return or destroy it when this
Agreement ends.
5. WARRANTIES. Each party warrants that it has the authority to enter into this Agreement
and that performing it will not breach any other agreement it is bound by.
6. TERMINATION. Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience on 60 days'
written notice, or immediately if the other party materially breaches this Agreement and
does not cure the breach within 30 days of written notice.
7. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY. Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential damages.
Each party's total liability is capped at the fees paid in the twelve months before the
claim.
8. GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Texas, without
regard to its conflict of laws rules.
9. ENTIRE AGREEMENT. This Agreement is the parties' entire agreement on its subject and
replaces all earlier proposals and understandings.
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have signed this Agreement as of the Effective Date.
